paper_title: First results of the CAST-RADES haloscope search for axions at 34.67 microeV
notes: CAST-RADES haloscope, 5 sub-cavity filter-like RF cavity in the CAST dipole magnet. Headline result quoted in abstract and Sec.3: exclusion g_agamma >~ 4e-13 GeV^-1 at 95% credibility over 34.6738 microeV < m_a < 34.6771 microeV (frequency ~8.384 GHz). Reported as a flat two-point line at 4e-13 GeV^-1 spanning the stated mass range; the actual limit is a shallow Lorentzian-shaped bathtub curve (inset of Fig.9 / Fig.8 in normalized power units) dipping somewhat below 4e-13 near resonance center, but the paper presents 4e-13 as its representative headline value. Local DM density rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (not rescaled). Systematics < 10% neglected in the limit.
